name: Headway
one_liner: Search for in-network therapists and psychiatric prescribers, book online, and pay only your insurance copay or coinsurance.
best_for: People with commercial insurance or select Medicare Advantage or Medicaid managed care plans who want therapy for their copay
People who want to choose their own therapist or prescriber from profiles
People who need medication management from an in-network psychiatrist or nurse practitioner
People who want an estimated cost before they book
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People without insurance or with Original Medicare (Headway has no self-pay option)
People whose plan is not accepted in their state
People who want text-based or messaging-only therapy
short_description: A directory of in-network therapists and prescribers; you book a session and pay only your insurance cost-share.
long_description: Headway is a US service that lists 80,000+ licensed therapists, psychiatrists and psychiatric nurse practitioners who are credentialed with insurance plans through Headway. You search by your insurance, state, specialty and availability, book online, and meet by video or, with many providers, in person. Headway bills your insurer, gives you an estimated per-session cost at booking, and charges your share (copay, coinsurance or deductible) after the visit; it charges no platform fee. Headway requires an in-network plan and has no cash-pay option. It accepts select Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care plans in some states, but not Original Medicare or Medicaid fee-for-service. Since July 2026, telehealth sessions with a provider not credentialed in the state where you are located are out of network. Late-cancellation fees are set by your provider and are not covered by insurance. Headway's privacy policy says it does not sell personal information or use it for targeted advertising; private class actions filed in 2024 and 2025 allege that website trackers sent data to Google and LinkedIn, and those claims are unresolved.
patient_summary: You enter your insurance on Headway, browse licensed therapists and psychiatric prescribers who are in network with your plan, and book a video or in-office session. Headway bills your insurer, shows an estimated cost when you book, and charges you only your copay, coinsurance or deductible after the session. You need an accepted insurance plan; there is no self-pay option.

pricing.starting_price: Copay or coinsurance with insurance; no self-pay option
pricing.notes: No platform fee; you pay your plan's cost-share (copay, coinsurance or deductible), billed after the session, with an estimate shown at booking. Medication-management visits can cost more than the estimate. Providers may charge late-cancellation fees that insurance does not cover. No cash-pay option.

privacy.notes: Policy says it does not use personal information for targeted advertising and did not sell or share it for cross-context ads in the prior 12 months; you can request deletion (health records kept as law requires). Unresolved private class actions (2024, 2025) allege trackers sent data to Google and LinkedIn; no regulator action found.

seo.title: Headway: Find In-Network Therapists & Psychiatrists
seo.meta_description: Headway helps you find therapists and psychiatrists who accept your insurance, with typical copays of $0-30 per session.

faqs.a: Headway is free to search and book—you only pay your insurance copay, typically $0-30 per session depending on your plan. There's no subscription fee or platform fee. You pay the same as any in-network provider visit.

Headway works with most major insurers including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Anthem, Oscar, and Medicare. Coverage varies by state and plan. Enter your insurance details on Headway to see available providers in your network.

faqs.q: How is Headway different from BetterHelp or Talkspace?
faqs.a: BetterHelp and Talkspace charge monthly subscriptions ($60-100/week) regardless of insurance. Headway providers bill your insurance directly, so you only pay your copay. If you have insurance with mental health coverage, Headway is typically much more affordable.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get an appointment through Headway?
faqs.a: Many Headway providers have next-day or same-week availability. The platform shows real-time availability and allows instant booking. This is often faster than calling in-network providers directly, as Headway aggregates availability across their network.

primary_uses: Medication management with an in-network psychiatrist or nurse practitioner
Weekly video or in-office therapy billed to insurance
Checking estimated session cost before booking

availability.note: US only; requires an in-network insurance plan. Select Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care plans in some states; not Original Medicare or Medicaid fee-for-service.
